# T-7: Update reasonsFromEvaluations to render per-violation rows

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
reasonsFromEvaluations emits ONE row per violation on FAIL article entries: verdict 'FAIL', detail '<title> — <target> — <why_violates>', plus a `where` field. PASS/SKIP article entries and all requirement entries emit one row each using `reason` (current behavior).

## Acceptance Criteria
- FAIL article entries with N violations produce N rows in data.artifacts.reasons.
- PASS / SKIP article entries produce 1 row each (current behavior).
- Requirement entries (parseImplRequirementEvaluation output) produce 1 row each (current behavior).

## Implementation Notes
reasonsFromEvaluations currently flatMaps evaluations into rows; extend to flatMap further when the entry has a violations[] array. Keep PASS/SKIP and requirement paths byteshape-identical.

## Test Strategy
Pure-function test on reasonsFromEvaluations with fixed evaluations[] mixing FAIL with two violations + PASS + SKIP; assert exact reasons[] shape including row count and field values. (reasonsFromEvaluations may need to be exported; if not, test indirectly via gate envelope output.)
